$comment: Reviewed licence exceptions for scripts/ci/check-client-licenses.mjs. An override names one package at one exact version; a new version needs a new review, including every @io-kit/* bump. licenseFile is the evidence the reviewer read (advisory; the gate does not open it). An override never rescues a GPL, AGPL, LGPL, EPL or SSPL licence. shippedDevDependencies lists devDependencies that are copied into the build output; they and their closure are checked like production packages. When data-navigator@3.0.0 (an MIT LICENSE file, no license field) is adopted, add its entry here in the same PR.
